whyItMatters: A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a source list that inherits every machine-level feed.
actions: Point the declaration or the registry configuration at the namespace the project controls, and remove the lookup path that resolves elsewhere. Specifically: fix a source list that inherits every machine-level feed.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm nuget.config no longer carries a source list that inherits every machine-level feed.
